about: Thirteen Landsat images of the same frame over Lake Mead, Hoover Dam to the Overton Arm, from 1984 to 2024, a map key of the named places in that frame, and the lake's end-of-month elevation record, committed here and checked by size and SHA-256.
rendering: Surface reflectance (scale 0.0000275, offset -0.2) of the red, green and blue bands, averaged onto the frame, then one fixed stretch for every image: reflectance 0 to 0.30, gamma 1/1.8, JPEG quality 88.
